SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No.…………
Special Branch…S.2. ………… 7550
REPORT
Date…October 3rd…1936 …… 35
Subject…Whereabouts of a prostitute named Lackey.
Made by…D.S Jones……………………Forwarded by…J Boyne D.S.I
In accordance with the instructions of the Officer i/c
Special Branch I showed the attached letter from Mr Sowle and
Police report dealing with the whereabouts of an American
prostitute known as "Babe" Lackey to Mr Pilcher of the U.S.
Consulate General. Mr Pilcher took copies of both the letter
and the report and returned the originals.
Attached is a copy of the letter sent by the American
Consul General in reply to the one received by the Commissioner
of Police from Mr Sowle.
C. S. Jones
D.S
Officer i/c Special Branch
（批：FILE 3/10）

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案号…………
特务科…S.2. ………… 7550
报告
日期…1936年10月3日…… 35
事由…名为 Lackey 的妓女之下落。
制作人…D.S Jones……………………转发人…J Boyne D.S.I
遵照特务科主管警官之指示，我将附呈之 Sowle 先生来信及关于一名被称为“Babe” Lackey 之美籍妓女下落之警务报告，出示给美国总领事馆之 Pilcher 先生。Pilcher 先生复印了该信件及报告，并将原件退回。
随函附上警察总监收到 Sowle 先生来信后，美国总领事回复信之副本。
C. S. Jones
副督察
特务科主管警官
（批注：归档 10/3）

Shanghai, China,
October 1, 1936.

Subject: Whereabouts of Miss Babe Lackey.

George R. Sowle, Esquire,
Box No. 311,
R. F. D. No. 1,
Menlo Park,
California.

Sir:

Your letter of August 15, 1936, addressed to the
Commissioner of Police of the Shanghai Municipal Council
in regard to the whereabouts of Miss Babe Lackey has been
referred to this Consulate General for reply.

There appears to be no record of Miss Lackey at this
Consulate General and the Police after making a thorough
search for her have reported that their efforts have
elicited no information whatsoever regarding her.

Very truly yours,

C. E. Gauss,
American Consul General.

中国上海，
1936年10月1日。

事由：Babe Lackey 小姐之下落。

George R. Sowle 先生，
311号信箱，
乡村邮递第1号路线，
门洛帕克，
加利福尼亚州。

先生：

您于1936年8月15日致上海公共租界工部局警察总监，查询 Babe Lackey 小姐下落之信函，已转交本总领事馆予以答复。

本总领事馆并无 Lackey 小姐之记录，警方经彻底搜寻后亦报告称，其努力未获得任何有关她之消息。

此致
敬礼

C. E. Gauss，
美国总领事。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section 2, Special Br. JJJJ/JJ,
REPORT
Date September 29, 1936
File No............

Subject Whereabouts of prostitute named Lackey.

Made by D. S. Jones Forwarded by J. Coyne Q S I

In connection with the attached letter of enquiry from
Mr. George R. Sowle regarding the present whereabouts of an
American prostitute named Babe Lackey, I have to state that
there is no record of such a person.
There are comparatively few American prostitutes actually
employed in brothels in Shanghai and those that follow this
calling seem to be well acquainted one with the other. Most
of these women have been interviewed regarding Lackey, but state
they do not know anybody of that name. Various brothel owners
have also been interviewed and are unanimous in stating that no-
one of this name has ever visited the brothels managed by them.
No American woman named Lackey has ever registered at the
American Consulate-General in Shanghai.

D. S. Jones
D. S.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
特务科第2股 JJJJ/JJ，
报告
日期 1936年9月29日
档案号............

事由 名为 Lackey 的妓女之下落。

制作人 D. S. Jones 转发人 J. Coyne Q S I

就附呈之 George R. Sowle 先生关于一名名为 Babe Lackey 之美籍妓女目前下落之查询信函，本人须声明，并无此人记录。
在上海妓院中实际受雇之美籍妓女为数相对较少，而那些从事此业者似乎彼此熟识。大多数此类妇女已就 Lackey 一事接受问询，但均表示不认识叫此名字的人。各妓院老鸨亦接受问询，并一致表示从未有叫此名字之人光顾由她们管理的妓院。
名为 Lackey 之美籍妇女从未在上海美国总领事馆登记。

D. S. Jones
副督察

特务科主管警官。

P.P.D#1 Box #311
Menlo Park, Calif
August 15, 1936.

Commissioner of Police
Shanghai Municipal Police.

Dear sir.
I am in search of the
whereabouts of a certain
woman who had at
my last knowledge of her been
living in Hsiao Pei.
Her residence started about
June 1933 until Dec 1934, from
Hsiao Pei and presumably not
coming to light now. I knew
her as Babe Lackey, & later knew
she worked in prostitution at 56...
...on Ferry Road.
It is vitally necessary to
me to know if she is in
Shanghai and also her worth
her while if I can get in touch
with her. My last knowledge
of her residence was in the
French Concession.
Thanking you for your
time and trouble, looking to
hear from you very soon.

Yours truly
George P. Lawl.

P.P.D#1 311号信箱
加利福尼亚州门洛帕克
1936年8月15日。

警察总监
上海公共租界工部局警务处。

尊敬的先生：
我正在寻找一位
女性的下落，据我
最后所知，她当时
居住在闸北。
她的居住时间大约从
1933年6月至1934年12月，在
闸北，推测目前并未
现身。我认识她时
她叫 Babe Lackey，后来知道
她在斐伦路56号……从事卖淫活动。
……
对我而言，至关重要的是
要知道她是否仍在
上海，以及如果我能够联系
上她，是否值得我这样做。我
最后所知她的居住地是在
法租界。
感谢您的
时间和麻烦，期待
尽快收到您的回音。

您真诚的
George P. Lawl.
